mapper.insert: INSERT INTO foods (user_id, food_code, food_name, category, serving_size, unit, calories, carbohydrate, protein, fat, sugars, sodium, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{foodCode}, #{foodName}, #{category}, #{servingSize}, #{unit}, #{calories}, #{carbohydrate}, #{protein}, #{fat}, #{sugars}, #{sodium}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT f.food_id AS foodId, f.food_name AS foodName, f.category AS category, f.serving_size AS servingSize, f.unit AS unit, f.calories AS calories FROM foods f
f.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY -- 1순위: 띄어쓰기 무시하고 이름이 완전히 똑같은 것 (예: "닭 가슴살" == "닭가슴살") CASE WHEN REPLACE(f.food_name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', '') THEN 1
-- 2순위: 검색어로 시작하는 것 (예: "닭가슴살 샐러드") WHEN REPLACE(f.food_name, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT(REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', ''), '%') THEN 2
-- 3순위: 중간에 포함된 것 (예: "훈제 닭가슴살") ELSE 3 END ASC,
-- 4순위: 글자 길이가 짧은 순 (더 일반적인 음식일 확률이 높음) LENGTH(REPLACE(f.food_name, ' ', '')) ASC,
-- 5순위: 가나다순 f.food_name ASC
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foods f
f.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT food_id AS foodId, food_code AS foodCode, food_name AS foodName, category AS category, serving_size AS servingSize, unit AS unit, calories AS calories, carbohydrate AS carbohydrate, protein AS protein, fat AS fat, sugars AS sugars, sodium AS sodium, user_id AS userId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM foods WHERE food_id = #{foodId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT food_id AS foodId, food_code AS foodCode, food_name AS foodName, category AS category, serving_size AS servingSize, unit AS unit, calories AS calories, carbohydrate AS carbohydrate, protein AS protein, fat AS fat, sugars AS sugars, sodium AS sodium, user_id AS userId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM foods WHERE REPLACE(food_name, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{foodName}, ' ', ''), '%') AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY -- 1순위: 이름이 정확히 일치하는 것 (예: "김치찌개") CASE WHEN REPLACE(food_name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(#{foodName}, ' ', '') THEN 1
-- 2순위: 검색어로 시작하는 것 (예: "김치찌개 정식") WHEN REPLACE(food_name, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT(REPLACE(#{foodName}, ' ', ''), '%') THEN 2
-- 3순위: 검색어가 중간/뒤에 포함된 것 (예: "돼지고기 김치찌개") ELSE 3 END ASC,
-- 4순위: 같은 우선순위라면 글자 길이가 짧은 순 (더 일반적인 음식일 확률 높음) LENGTH(REPLACE(food_name, ' ', '')) ASC,
-- 5순위: 가나다순 food_name ASC
LIMIT 5
mapper.update: UPDATE foods SET deleted_at = NOW(), food_code = CONCAT(food_code, #{deleteSuffix}) WHERE food_id = #{foodId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM foods WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' ORDER BY category ASC
